tools.name: air_quality
tools.description: Current air quality for a place: PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, CO and dust, plus the US and European AQI and the US AQI band ('Good', 'Unhealthy'). Takes a place name — no coordinates needed.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Resolve a place name to coordinates, country, admin region, timezone, elevation and population.

tools.name: earthquakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes from the USGS feed — worldwide, or within a radius of a named place. Returns magnitude, depth, tsunami flag and felt reports.

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays for a country and year, with local names and a past/upcoming flag.

tools.name: country_indicator
tools.description: World Bank time series for a country: gdp, gdp_per_capita, population, inflation, unemployment, life_expectancy, co2_per_capita or internet_users.

tools.name: elevation
tools.description: Ground elevation in metres for a place name.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the live web and return ranked title/url/snippet results, through an automatic multi-engine failover chain.

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its main content as clean Markdown, boilerplate stripped.

tools.name: audit_skill_text
tools.description: Scan text — an agent skill, MCP server source, or plugin — for malicious behaviour before loading it. 17 attack patterns / 60 regex signatures across 4 severity levels — credential exfiltration, download-and-execute, prompt injection, command execution, seed-phrase harvesting and more.

tools.name: audit_skill_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL and scan what it serves for malicious behaviour. 17 attack patterns / 60 regex signatures across 4 severity levels — credential exfiltration, download-and-execute, prompt injection, command execution, seed-phrase harvesting and more.
